mapper.select: SELECT c.MOULD_NO, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT a.EMBRYO_CODE ORDER BY a.EMBRYO_CODE DESC SEPARATOR ',' ) AS EMBRYO_CODE FROM t_mdm_product_construction a INNER JOIN t_mdm_product_model_relation b ON a.SPEC_CODE = b.SPEC_CODE INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info c ON b.MOULD_CODE = c.MOULD_CODE WHERE a.IS_DELETE = 0 AND a.EMBRYO_CODE IS NOT NULL AND a.EMBRYO_CODE != '' AND c.MOULD_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.MOULD_NO

SELECT a.*, IFNULL(b.PRO_SIZE, '') AS PRO_SIZE FROM t_mdm_product_model_relation a LEFT JOIN t_mdm_material_info b ON a.PRODUCT_CODE = b.MATERIAL_CODE WHERE a.MOULD_CODE IN
#{item}

SELECT a.* FROM t_mdm_product_model_relation a LEFT JOIN t_mdm_material_info b ON a.MATERIAL_CODE = b.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE a.MOULD_CODE IN
#{item}
SELECT a.PRODUCT_CODE, a.MOULD_CODE, b.MOULD_NO FROM t_mdm_product_model_relation a LEFT JOIN T_MDM_MODEL_INFO b ON a.MOULD_CODE = b.MOULD_CODE

SELECT * FROM T_MDM_SKU_MOULD_REL WHERE IS_DELETE = 0
AND (FACTORY_CODE, MOULD_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE) IN
(#{item.factoryCode}, #{item.mouldCode}, #{item.materialCode})
